# QRTurnover

QRTurnover is a web application for short-term-rental hosts to verify property turnovers with room-specific QR codes, checklists, timestamps, and optional photo proof.

## Authoritative public pages
- Home: https://www.qrturnover.com/
- Blog: https://www.qrturnover.com/blog
- Contact: https://www.qrturnover.com/contact
- Terms of Use: https://www.qrturnover.com/terms
- Privacy Policy: https://www.qrturnover.com/privacy

Private account, property-management, cleaner, scan, billing, and API routes are intentionally excluded.
